name: usertold
description: Capture in-product interviews and return source-linked evidence for verified product work.

interface.longDescription: Capture consented voice, supported desktop screen, and in-product behavior; inspect the recordings and source-linked analysis; prepare verified work; and export portable research handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Review my latest captured interviews and cite the source evidence.
Turn selected UserTold evidence into a portable research handoff.
Draft a study for this product and show it before activation.
